## Edit Screen A: the note (its positions are its row on Settings)
  1  PUT /api/operator-stations/11
       {
         "process_id": 1,
         "code": "scr-a",
         "name": "Screen A",
         "note": "front HMI, moved",
         "area_label": "Bay 1",
         "sequence": 1,
         "controller_node_id": "",
         "enabled": true
       }
  2  GET /api/operator-stations
  3  GET /api/operator-stations/11/claimed-nodes
  4  GET /api/processes
  5  GET /api/processes/1/composer?map_rev=map-r1
  6  GET /api/processes/1/styles
  7  POST /api/processes/1/flow/preview?steps=1
       (the boot preview's body, as requests-open-process.txt pins it)
-- sheet closed

## Settings › + Add a screen on Press A with no screen: Screen C, taking the positions on no screen
  1  POST /api/operator-stations
       {
         "process_id": 1,
         "code": "",
         "name": "Screen C",
         "note": "spare",
         "area_label": "",
         "sequence": 0,
         "controller_node_id": "",
         "enabled": true
       }
  2  PUT /api/operator-stations/31/claimed-nodes
       {
         "nodes": [
           "POS_A1",
           "POS_A2",
           "POS_A3",
           "POS_A4",
           "POS_A5",
           "POS_A6",
           "POS_A7",
           "POS_A8",
           "POS_A9",
           "POS_A10",
           "POS_A11",
           "POS_B1",
           "POS_B2",
           "POS_B3",
           "POS_B4",
           "ULD_1"
         ]
       }
  3  GET /api/operator-stations
  4  GET /api/operator-stations/31/claimed-nodes
  5  GET /api/process-nodes
  6  GET /api/processes
  7  GET /api/processes/1/composer?map_rev=map-r1
  8  GET /api/processes/1/styles
  9  GET /api/process-nodes
 10  GET /api/processes/1/station-counters
 11  GET /api/processes/1/counting-slots
 12  GET /api/processes/1/catid-health
 13  GET /api/processes/1/presets
 14  GET /api/processes/1/auto-reorder
-- sheet closed

## Settings › Positions and routing › the Positions box: POS_A11 off and NEW_3 on, Save; the removal is asked about first, and Save again takes it off
  1  GET /api/operator-stations/11/claimed-nodes
  2  POST /api/operator-stations/11/claimed-nodes/impact
       {
         "nodes": [
           "POS_A1",
           "POS_A2",
           "POS_A3",
           "POS_A4",
           "POS_A5",
           "POS_A6",
           "POS_A7",
           "POS_A8",
           "POS_A9",
           "POS_A10",
           "NEW_3"
         ]
       }
  3  PUT /api/operator-stations/11/claimed-nodes
       {
         "nodes": [
           "POS_A1",
           "POS_A2",
           "POS_A3",
           "POS_A4",
           "POS_A5",
           "POS_A6",
           "POS_A7",
           "POS_A8",
           "POS_A9",
           "POS_A10",
           "NEW_3"
         ]
       }
  4  GET /api/process-nodes
  5  GET /api/processes/1/station-counters
  6  GET /api/processes/1/composer?map_rev=map-r1
-- notice: success "Saved"
-- sheet closed
